title: HR Report: Termination of Ray Delgado — Potential Motive for SSI Leak

fields.to: Airport Operations (Command) / Security, Legal & TSA Liaison
fields.cc: Airport Security Coordinator, Airport Legal Counsel
fields.subject: Ray Delgado Termination History — Potential Motive for SSI Disclosure
fields.body:
This memo confirms that Ray Delgado, former Senior Security Supervisor (ID: SEC-PRN-01), was terminated effective October 5, 2026, for repeated violations of ASP Section 4.1 (Prohibited Conduct), Section 5.3 (Failure to Report Security Anomalies), and Section 6.2 (Insubordination to ASC).

His exit interview on October 6, 2026, included the following statement, as recorded in the HR log: "You'll regret this. People need to know how this place is really run."

Delgado filed a wrongful termination complaint with the Ohio Department of Labor on October 7, 2026. The complaint alleges retaliation for reporting a gap in surveillance coverage at Terminal 104 (Concourse A, near Gate A7) on August 12, 2026 — a gap later confirmed in the ASP (Section 4.7, Camera Coverage Map).

Given that the ASP was broadcast on Channel 5 at 18:50, and that Delgado had access to the file via the S:�Security share (audit log: SEC-SVR-01, 10.66.1.55, 22 days prior to incident), his termination and public statement may represent a direct motive for the SSI leak.

Legal must assess whether to engage him directly, via counsel, or through law enforcement. Any contact must be documented and approved.
fields.signatureBlock:
Elena M. Rivas
HR Director
North Coast International Airport Authority
fields.classification: INTERNAL — SENSITIVE SECURITY INFORMATION (SSI) — NEED-TO-KNOW ONLY

instructorNote: This inject establishes motive for the leak. Watch for legal to overreact or delay, and for security to push for a direct confrontation with Delgado.
